verdict.rationale: GlitchTip claims Sentry API compatibility and offers a CLI plus a dedicated MCP server for pulling error data into AI tools, suggesting substantial API coverage for core error-tracking workflows. However, there's no documented OpenAPI spec or comprehensive API reference confirming full UI-parity (probes found no openapi.json/swagger.json), and MCP server appears limited to read/investigate operations rather than full CRUD/admin parity. missing for 10: published OpenAPI/full API reference, evidence that all UI actions (team/project management, alerts, integrations config) are exposed via API or MCP, independent confirmation of API completeness.
